notes: Linear / Radial ramp, colours, points and alpha handling are pixel-exact vs AE 8 bpc (ramp evaluated at the pixel's integer corner, t clamped, straight colour quantised to 8 bits then premultiplied by the layer alpha; the layer colours are replaced, its alpha kept). Point defaults [320,0]/[320,360] are AE's top-centre/bottom-centre for the 640x360 test layer (AE uses the layer's own size). Ramp Scatter (6): AE's dither noise is proprietary and was not in the visible refs; approximated as a stable per-pixel uniform jitter of +-scatter/2 px along the ramp (structure only, not the AE noise pattern). Blend With Original (7): mix(ramp, original) in premultiplied space (alpha identical on both sides), not measured on a visible ref. Colour alpha components are ignored (AE colour params are RGB). Param 8 is an AE UI group end, 9 = Composite Options (not reproduced). Start == End: degenerate, guarded (t saturates to 1 past the start).
